property_summary: For any value v, calling SetMinSum(v) on a fresh contract sets MinSum to v and the lock is released afterwards, so a second SetMinSum with any value v2 also succeeds and leaves MinSum == v2; the buggy lock never releases, so the second call reverts and MinSum stays at v.
change_summary: Change `locked_ = false;` in the epilogue of nonReentrant_ to `locked_ = true;` so the lock is never released, making a subsequent SetMinSum call revert and leaving MinSum unchanged.
